skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in Python.

questions.question: What does the 'yield' keyword do inside a function?
options: Turns the function into a generator that produces values lazily

questions.question: Which data structure has O(1) average lookup time in Python?
What is the key difference between shallow and deep copy?
options: Shallow copies references; deep copy clones nested objects recursively

questions.question: What is __init__ in Python classes?
What does the GIL prevent in CPython?
options: Multiple native threads executing Python bytecodes simultaneously

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of multi-stage Docker builds?
options: Drastically minimizes final production image size

questions.question: What is the key difference between CMD and ENTRYPOINT?
options: ENTRYPOINT defines executable; CMD provides default overridable arguments

questions.question: Which command cleans unused containers, networks, and dangling images?

options: Persisting data outside container writable layers

questions.question: Which flag runs a container in detached background mode?

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in SQL.

questions.question: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING?
options: WHERE filters rows before aggregation; HAVING filters groups after aggregation

questions.question: Which index type is default for range and equality queries in relational databases?
What does an INNER JOIN return?
options: Only rows matching the join predicate in both tables

questions.question: Which constraint enforces distinct values in a column?
What does the ROW_NUMBER() window function do?
options: Assigns sequential integers to rows within a partition starting at 1

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in TypeScript.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'type' and 'interface' in TypeScript?
options: Interfaces can be declaration merged; types support unions and primitives

questions.question: What does the 'keyof' operator produce?
options: A union of string/numeric literal keys of a type

questions.question: What does 'unknown' represent compared to 'any'?
options: Type-safe counterpart to any that requires type narrowing before use

questions.question: What does the 'readonly' modifier do on properties?
What is a generic type in TypeScript?
options: A parameterized reusable type defined with angle brackets <T>

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in JavaScript (ES6+).

questions.question: What is the JavaScript Event Loop responsible for?
options: Coordinating synchronous code execution and asynchronous callbacks in the queue

questions.question: What is closure in JavaScript?
options: A function that retains access to its lexical scope even when executed outside that scope

questions.question: What does Promise.all() do when one promise rejects?
What is the difference between == and ===?
options: === checks both value and type without coercion

questions.question: What does Array.prototype.reduce() return?
options: A single accumulated value resulting from the reducer callback

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in Node.js.

questions.question: What engine powers Node.js under the hood?
What does process.nextTick() do?
options: Schedules callback to run before the next event loop iteration

questions.question: Why should synchronous fs functions like readFileSync be avoided in web servers?
options: They block the entire Node.js single-threaded event loop

questions.question: What is libuv in Node.js architecture?
options: A multi-platform C library providing asynchronous I/O and thread pooling

questions.question: How do Node.js Streams improve memory efficiency?
options: Processing data piece by piece (chunking) without loading whole files into RAM

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in Next.js.

questions.question: What is the key benefit of React Server Components (RSC) in Next.js App Router?
options: Zero JavaScript bundle sent to the client for server-rendered components

questions.question: What does the 'use client' directive declare in Next.js?
options: Declares client boundary where interactive hooks like useState/useEffect can be used

questions.question: What is Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)?
options: Rebuilding entire site on every request
Updating specific static pages in the background without full rebuild

questions.question: Where are Server Actions executed in Next.js?
Which component optimizes images with lazy loading and WebP formats?

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in Kubernetes.

questions.question: What is the smallest deployable computing unit in Kubernetes?
What is the primary role of a Kubernetes Deployment?
options: Declaratively managing Pods, replicas, and rolling updates

questions.question: What component is the distributed key-value store in a Kubernetes control plane?
What does a Kubernetes Service do?
options: Provides an abstract stable network endpoint and load balancing for a set of Pods

questions.question: What does Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) adjust?
options: Number of Pod replicas based on observed CPU/memory utilization

skillQuizzes.description: 5-question timed benchmark covering fundamental and advanced concepts in Git & GitHub.

questions.question: What does 'git rebase' do compared to 'git merge'?
options: Re-applies commits on top of another base tip creating a linear commit history

questions.question: What does 'git cherry-pick' do?
options: Applies the changes introduced by a specific existing commit onto the current branch

questions.question: What is the purpose of the staging area in Git?
options: Allowing developers to format and review changes before committing

questions.question: What does 'git stash' do?
options: Temporarily shelves uncommitted changes so you can work on another branch

questions.question: What is a detached HEAD state in Git?
options: HEAD points directly to a commit rather than a branch reference

questions.question: Does Go support classical class-based inheritance?

options: String is an allocated growable heap buffer; &str is an immutable string slice

questions.question: What does the 'mut' keyword declare?
What are lifetimes ('a) used for in Rust?
options: Helping compiler ensure that references do not outlive the data they point to
